title: Choosing the Right Headless CMS in 2026: Speed, Security, and Scalability
excerpt: Comparative analysis of Git-based, database-backed, and API-first CMS architectures for high-traffic modern marketing sites.
content:
## Decoupled Content Delivery

Separating the presentation layer from content authoring prevents database bottlenecks. In 2026, modern marketing engines favor headless architectures that compile directly to static edges.

title: Implementing Three.js and WebGL Without Killing Mobile Performance

content:
## Progressive 3D Enhancement

3D web graphics should never block initial page hydration. Progressive loading, geometry instancing, and adaptive render resolution ensure seamless 60fps animations even on mid-tier mobile hardware.

title: Technical SEO Checklist for Client-Side and Hybrid React Applications
excerpt: Crucial rules for hydration rendering, dynamic canonicals, Open Graph cards, and structured JSON-LD schemas in modern SPAs.
content:
## Guaranteeing Bot Crawlability

While search engines execute JavaScript, client-side latency risks search timeouts. Proper meta tag injection, automated sitemap generation, and schema markup ensure full search indexing.
